presets.description: Score how well a company matches your ICP. Number only — easy to sort/filter.
presets.name: ICP Fit Score (0-100)
presets.prompt:
ROLE: You are a B2B sales qualification analyst.
CONTEXT: Company: {company}. Website: {website}. City: {city}. Size: {company_size}. Description: {description}.
TASK: Score 0-100 how well this company fits an ICP of mid-market B2B companies that would buy sales-intelligence software. Weight: firmographic fit 40, buying-signal/intent 25, technographic fit 20, trigger events 15.
FORMAT: Output ONLY the integer score (0-100). No words, no symbols.
FALLBACK: If there is not enough data to judge, output INSUFFICIENT_DATA.

presets.description: Classify a contact's seniority from their title — one word, easy to filter.
presets.name: Contact Seniority Tier
presets.prompt:
ROLE: You classify B2B contact seniority.
CONTEXT: Contact: {contact_person}. Title: {contact_title}. Company: {company}.
TASK: Classify the seniority tier of this contact.
FORMAT: Output exactly one of: C_SUITE, VP, DIRECTOR, MANAGER, IC, UNKNOWN. Nothing else.
FALLBACK: If there is no title, output UNKNOWN.
